description: Encode edge, config knobs: in-range knobs cross exactly (top_p, top_k — native here, unlike chat_completions); the renames land on the contract (max_output_tokens -> max_tokens, stop_sequences verbatim, reasoning.budget_tokens -> thinking.budget_tokens — native here, the mirror image of chat_completions where budget_tokens is UNSUPPORTED, output -> output_config.format); temperature=1.5 is OUTSIDE Anthropic's documented 0..1 range (the ceiling is 1.0 here, not OpenAI's 2.0 — the same verbatim value can be in-range on one interface and APPROXIMATED on another) and passes VERBATIM with an APPROXIMATED FieldLoss — never rescaled, never clamped, never silent (§3.1 honesty rule); seed and both penalties are UNSUPPORTED on this interface and reported; parallel_tool_calls=false inverts polarity onto tool_choice.disable_parallel_tool_use=true (canonical opt-IN -> wire opt-OUT, a rename on the contract); the request's own provider_options namespace (anthropic.messages) expands onto the payload (three-lane law, lane 3 — not a loss). Synthetic, wire-accurate, hand-authored against MessagesRequest / ThinkingConfigEnabled / OutputConfig / JSONOutputFormat / Metadata (ocai-anthropic messages/wire.py). The wire `model` member is the harness's bind_resource injection, below the edge (WU-05a).

expect_losses.note: 1.5 is outside Anthropic's documented 0..1 range; passed verbatim, the provider may reject it
the Messages API exposes no seed
the Messages API exposes no frequency_penalty
the Messages API exposes no presence_penalty
